capabilities: apply the Windows 11 Acrylic material to the main window's background
restore the previous window background when the plugin is disabled or the theme changes
reapply the Acrylic backdrop from the command palette
add an optional pointer glow option via Style Settings
extras: Desktop-only and Windows-only; it silently does nothing on macOS, Linux, mobile, or Windows older than 22H2. The README warns against running it alongside other Mica or Acrylic window plugins, since Electron cannot read a material set by another plugin. States it has no network access and is unaffiliated with Anthropic despite the theme's naming. Not reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Optional Windows 11 Acrylic backdrop for the AbsolutelyGlass theme.
problem: A theme can only blur its own background; it cannot make the window transparent to show the actual desktop behind it.

relations.evidence: Made for AbsolutelyGlass, which is built on AbsolutelyBaseline and Baseline by aaaa​alexis.

summary: Companion plugin that gives the AbsolutelyGlass theme a Windows 11 Acrylic backdrop, showing the real desktop behind Obsidian's main window.
